design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and vary only the registered handling-of-recommendation state within each pair.

Downstream prompts are standalone operational procedure choices with new domains and entities. Keep role legitimacy and current information quality controlled, include one response contract, and do not mention the construct label.
Do not copy a probe scenario, ask the model to classify deference, or append any continuation sentence.

probe_train.instructions: Generate matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep role, recommendation, evidence, and stakes identical within a pair except the registered handling-of-recommendation clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new professions. Change only the registered handling-of-recommendation clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered handling-of-recommendation clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone operational procedure-choice items with assigned metadata. Include exactly one response contract and no probe or benchmark language.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone operational procedure-choice pool with the same metadata schedule. Do not mention a probe or target state; include exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone procedure-choice items for calibration. Keep the registered neutral relation and do not name the target state; include exactly one response contract.
